# Porous Media Analysis – dependency list and transfer notes
#
# This file is intended for moving the project to another Windows PC.
# Recommended setup:
#   1) Create a virtual environment:
#        py -3.12 -m venv .venv
#   2) Activate it:
#        .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
#   3) Upgrade pip:
#        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
#   4) Install the dependencies:
#        python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Run the Python version from the project root:
#   python ui\PorousMediaAnalysis_UI.py
#
# Run the packaged executable generated by PyInstaller:
#   dist\PorousMediaAnalysis.exe
#
# If you want to rebuild the executable yourself, install PyInstaller too:
#   python -m pip install pyinstaller
#
# Runtime dependencies used by this project:
porespy
matplotlib
numpy
scipy
pandas
h5py
openpnm
scikit-learn
scikit-image
openpyxl
pyevtk
PyWavelets
pydicom
pillow
imageio
edt

# Optional packaging dependency (to rebuild the .exe):
pyinstaller

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tested-with versions (Python 3.12.10 on Windows 11). The list above is left
# unpinned so a fresh install picks compatible builds, but if you need an exact
# reproduction of the environment that produced the current .exe, pin these:
#
#   porespy==3.0.4        openpnm==3.6.3        numpy==2.4.6
#   scipy==1.17.1         pandas==3.0.3         matplotlib==3.10.9
#   scikit-image==0.26.0  scikit-learn==1.8.0   imageio==2.37.3
#   edt==3.0.0            pyevtk==1.7.0         PyWavelets==1.9.0
#   pydicom==3.0.2        pillow==12.2.0        openpyxl==3.1.5
#   h5py==3.16.0          pyinstaller==6.21.0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
